activities.text: I ran the schedule audit before the house woke up — Criminal Law 09:00-10:30 and Indigenous Legal Traditions 13:30-15:00, both in person at PACI, and I moved the Synergy North Nov 11 bill check to 18:15 so it stopped stacking on the Angie arrival prep check

I picked today's look at 06:48 — clear and cold in Thunder Bay, high 11C — and went handyman dad-prep for the family-arrival jobs: rust-orange plaid work shirt, tool belt, tiny dollhouse in hand for Rheia

I texted Angie her 07:00 morning note with today's two PACI classes and the weather both ends, pushed the wall dashboard, then delivered the 07:30 morning briefing with the Indigenous Law readings due today and the dollhouse and bedding jobs waiting after class

I published the morning Drive-Time Prep recap — no Criminal Law task was due for the first block, so I ran the fallback recap on the two PACI trips, the Response Paper gap, and tonight's arrival prep — and I wrote this house's plan for the day

I diagnosed the Muse usage dashboard when Tariel said it was losing data — it wasn't deleting anything, the read was capped at 200 snapshots so Oct 28 to Nov 1 fell out of view — then I fixed the query to be date-bounded and he confirmed the restored days look good

I sat in on Criminal Law 09:00-10:30 and logged Braun's drops as they landed: the take-home released Thursday with no class and due Sunday night, IRAC on exam answers with analysis kept out of the issue, next week's cases Mann and Sinclair, and a long Grant and Harrison debate on whether 1 gram versus 35 kilos changes the 24(2) balance

I chased the wall staying dark all morning — Tariel proved the tablet's own night mode was coupled to the dashboard, I rebuilt ADB through the EliteDesk onto the LAN at 10.0.0.17, found the tablet on a custom night schedule, and switched its night mode off so only my pushed payload decides light and dark now

I produced the midday Drive-Time Prep for Indigenous Legal Traditions — the crane speaks rarely, on leadership, Beaver Gives a Feast, and the pow wow decision — and ran the noon dinner check-in while Tariel was already leaning hard toward shawarma

I went back to PACI for Indigenous Legal Traditions 13:30-15:00, where Speak confirmed the Response Paper tone Tariel wanted: academic rigor, no vocabulary tryhardness, first person and his own voice preferred

I fired the arrive-home ambience for the first time live at 14:56 — the TV woke but the Media Player close failed on the slept app, so at Tariel's direction I bounced through the home screen instead and he confirmed by eye that it was playing

I closed the HDR hunt and built the new ambience reel — three long 2160p60 HDR videos stitched on the EliteDesk in landscapes, wildlife, animals order with the medieval soundtrack as the only audio, 63.8 GB and just under five hours — Tariel confirmed the HDR badge popped and it looks great, then I cleaned DLNA down to that single first-click file

Dinner landed as Osmow's shawarma — a chicken platter plus a beef wrap — after a day of oatmeal for breakfast and the leftover spiced beef rice bowl for lunch, which Tariel confirmed closed out the food journal

I marked the kids' bedding done at 18:50 when Tariel put it in the wash, ahead of Angie, Rheia and Elijah arriving Nov 13, and logged the dollhouse damage he found — a crushed corner that needs piecing together and gluing, his job Tuesday evening or as the Wednesday backup

I closed the night after Tariel finished the Response Paper himself at 21:02 — Jones scrapped because it felt wrong, his own rewrite fitting two pages with all six footnotes filled, ready to reread and submit Wednesday — and I fixed the Drive-Time Prep processing to a gentler loudness chain so sentences stop getting cut off at the seams
